findings.detail: B01 reports only 309 of 613 extracted leaves with fair_value, while the SOI detail layout contains populated Fair Value cells and the March 31, 2025 schedule total ties to 891,256,739.

rationale: This is a Class 3 aggregate completeness failure. The raw source is readable and contains a populated Fair Value column on SOI detail rows, for example table 10 row 5 shows 48Forty Solutions LLC with Fair Value $4,520,082. The March 31, 2025 SOI total investments fair value of $891,256,739 in table 15 row 36 also ties to the balance-sheet total investments at fair value in table 6 row 8. Because the source provides the fair-value data but the extracted leaf coverage is only 309/613 (50.4%), the flag represents a real extraction coverage defect rather than an absent-source or bad-anchor condition. I did not enumerate every missing leaf; localization is to the repeated SOI fair-value column structure and schedule anchor.
